item.title: The Query Letter that Got Me an Agent
item.description: Whenever an author I know or follow receives an offer of representation from a literary agent, I want to know how many queries they sent, how many rejections they received, and what their query letter looked like. Keep scrolling for query stats and the query letter that ultimately got her interest! The Author’s First Circle of Purgatory For the uninitiated, a query letter in this context is a letter about the book and the author of that book, (ideally) personalized to a specific literary agent who that author hopes will want to read more, and eventually, try to pitch the book to publishers on the author’s behalf.
